name: Mool Role Restrictor
author: mool

sections.description:
Mool Role Restrictor lets administrators control wp-admin access per role.

Features:
* Restrict admin menus per role
* Block direct wp-admin URLs
* Hide admin bar, notices, Screen Options & Help tabs
* Media library: own uploads only
* Disable delete, comments, updates
* Force Classic Editor per role

Donation

This plugin is free.
Optional donations support ongoing development:
https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=LFP32BTCWEGGE
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Settings → Role Restrictor

short_description: Restrict WordPress admin access per role using one clean settings page.
